verdict.rationale: Vercel documents a REST API and SDK for programmatic account interaction, and a live probe confirms a published OpenAPI description. Scoped access tokens authenticate both the API and the CLI. The CLI covers logs, certificates, DNS and local environment replication, and webhooks expose deployment and project events, so the platform is clearly API-first for its core surfaces. missing for 10: an explicit documented statement or audit of API/UI parity, evidence that newer dashboard features (e.g., Vercel Agent dashboard chat, toolbar/comments) are API-accessible, independent hands-on corroboration of coverage.
